issues.title: Complete five-seed experiment was not prospectively frozen
issues.finding: Seed 2026 test results were observed as a W3 pilot before the W4 freeze manifest was created; only seeds 2027-2030 were new after freeze.
issues.required_action: Disclose the reused observed pilot and replace full-study confirmatory/prespecified language unless a pre-W3 timestamped protocol exists.
issues.verification: Text states exact seed provenance and timing; no unsupported confirmatory/preregistered wording remains.

issues.title: Holm correction is asserted but absent
artifact_evidence: workspace/w6_c2_canonical_v2/**: no Holm or adjusted-p result
issues.finding: The frozen analysis reports raw paired t/sign-flip p-values and CI gates; it does not define or apply Holm families.
issues.required_action: Remove the claim or add traceable family definitions and adjusted results, labeled retrospective unless prospectively documented.
issues.verification: Every multiplicity statement maps to code and a canonical adjusted-results table, or Holm is absent from the paper.

issues.title: Upstream classifier is under-specified and fixed across downstream seeds
issues.finding: One TF-IDF/logistic-regression role ledger is reused for all five downstream seeds, but configuration and uncertainty scope are not reported.
issues.required_action: Report the complete upstream configuration and state that uncertainty excludes upstream refits; add a separately labeled sensitivity if feasible.
issues.verification: A reader can reproduce the ledger and correctly interpret the seed/bootstrap variance.

issues.title: Registered downstream architecture and optimization are incompletely specified
issues.finding: Architecture size, dropout, exact floors/init, auxiliary coefficient, TF-IDF setup, batching, optimizer defaults, and local-channel details are omitted.
issues.required_action: Add a complete implementation table and total-loss equation; deposit executable code and an environment lock.
issues.verification: Independent reproduction requires no undocumented hyperparameter choices.

issues.title: FEVER conversion and deterministic split are not fully documented
issues.finding: Source revision, exclusions, evidence mapping, hash assignment, deduplication, pooling, and document-boundary limiting are omitted.
issues.required_action: Document the full conversion algorithm, counts by exclusion reason, source snapshot, hashes, and split parameters; deposit conversion code.
issues.verification: A clean regeneration produces the frozen manifest hashes and split counts.

issues.title: No permanent submission-ready reproducibility package
artifact_evidence: Local canonical v2 artifacts exist but no public DOI/URL is supplied
issues.finding: The supplement is conditional and the data-availability statement contains a repository placeholder.
issues.required_action: Deposit permitted artifacts with DOI/URL, licenses, hashes, code, environment, ledgers, checkpoints/configs, and verification instructions.
issues.verification: All cited artifacts resolve from a permanent public record or have exact restriction-aware regeneration instructions.

issues.title: Component attribution is discussed while available frozen ablations are omitted
issues.finding: Canonical v2 retains full/BM25 only although source runs contain additional modes; the shared-component interpretation is not directly shown.
issues.required_action: Report frozen modes as exploratory ablations or soften attribution and justify their exclusion.
issues.verification: Every component-performance interpretation is supported by a presented frozen contrast or clearly labeled as hypothesis.

issues.title: Gate wording and captions omit one required interval
issues.finding: Some text says hierarchical CI alone determines the gate, while code and the correct methods sentence require seed-level and hierarchical CIs.
issues.required_action: Use the exact two-interval gate definition everywhere and expose both intervals.
issues.verification: Methods, captions, tables, and Results describe identical gate logic.

issues.title: Oracle-label is not a guaranteed upper bound
issues.finding: Privileged role access is a conditional sensitivity, not a mathematical upper bound, and observed ordering is not uniform.
issues.required_action: Replace upper-bound with privileged-label conditional sensitivity diagnostic.
issues.verification: No upper-bound wording remains unless formally defined and demonstrated.

issues.title: The 180,000-row canonical ledger scope is ambiguous
issues.finding: Source runs total 810,000 rows, whereas canonical v2 retains 180,000 full/BM25 rows.
issues.required_action: Distinguish full source-ledger audit coverage from reduced canonical release scope.
issues.verification: All row counts name modes, seeds, cutoffs, and inclusion scope.

issues.title: Bootstrap estimand and Monte Carlo details need clarification
issues.finding: The implementation is an instance-weighted percentile hierarchical cluster bootstrap with replacement, but weighting and RNG details are not stated.
issues.required_action: State weighting, replacement, percentile CI, RNG strategy, and 2,000-replicate limitation; optionally add a stability sensitivity.
issues.verification: The written algorithm reproduces canonical interval endpoints.

issues.title: Readable PDF retains warnings and placeholder metadata
issues.finding: No undefined references were found, but fancyhdr/hyperref warnings remain and author metadata is a placeholder.
issues.required_action: Clear warnings/placeholders and verify deterministic pagination/metadata before submission.
issues.verification: Clean compile, consistent page count, final metadata, no undefined references/citations.
